_comment: List prices in USD per million tokens. Keys are matched as substrings of the model id that appears in Claude Code transcripts, longest key first. Order within each model: uncached input, 5-minute cache write, 1-hour cache write, cache read, output. Override for your own account by copying this file to $LACUNA_DATA/pricing.json and editing it; that copy wins and survives plugin updates.
_caveat: List price, not your bill. Subscription plans, rate limits, batch discounts and enterprise agreements are not modelled. Every figure this plugin prints is an estimate.
